regime_context: US thematic landscape on 2026-10-08 shows AI Infrastructure as the lone clear leader (score 1.975, eligible, not crowded, but durability_bar 0.68 and breadth 0.708 suggest fading cohesion). Momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), and the rotation radar is non-directional (margin 0.348, absorption 0.31, no confirmed handoff). The one validated leg here is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so any directional lean must be tempered by what the trend-health legs actually show.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Cybersecurity's crowding flag (z 1.8) resolves via breadth decay rather than price — if CIBR breadth (fraction of constituents above their own trend) slips below 0.7 while durability_bar holds above 0.8, the crowding is rotating internally rather than breaking the trend; the watch retires if CIBR breadth drops under 0.6 with two consecutive weekly closes below the 50-day.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity sits at rank 2 with the strongest trend-health profile in the eligible set: durability_bar 0.85 (highest of any ranked theme) and breadth 1.0 (full participation), tagged 'trend'. The absolute-trend gate — the only validated edge — is satisfied here, while the leader (AI Infra) shows a lower durability_bar of 0.68 with mixed Hurst. Crowding z of 1.8 is a size-down caution, not a fade; the trend leg supports holding a directional lean as long as trend-health remains intact.
evidence: Cybersecurity durability_bar 0.85 (highest in ranks), breadth 1.0, hurst_tag 'trend'
crowding_z 1.8 → size-down caution only, per guardrails (never a fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.8 is the highest in the table; if reflexivity unwinds, a crowded trend-leader can give back gains quickly, and the rank lead over the broader tech complex may already reflect chase-in flow that historically marks local tops.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its 50-day moving average and breadth (fraction of constituents above their own trend) drops under 0.6 within the 20-day window

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex (rank 4) is eligible and tagged 'trend' with durability_bar 0.68 and breadth 0.727 — solid, non-crowded (z 0.83) trend-health. Unlike the crowded Cybersecurity leg, energy is not flagged for crowding, so the trend gate's drawdown-control edge applies without the reflexivity caveat. The lean is anchored purely to the validated gate leg: stay long the trend as long as the absolute-trend condition holds.
theses.dissent: Energy is a classic mean-reverting macro trade; a headline-driven reversal in the underlying commodity (unscheduled share is 1.0, i.e. all recent macro flow is surprise-driven) could break the trend quickly, and rank 4 may simply reflect a late-cycle inflation hedge bid rather than a durable narrative.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day moving average and breadth drops below 0.5 within the 20-day window

theses.subject: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
theses.thesis: Non-AI Tech & Hardware (rank 9) is eligible, tagged 'trend', with the second-highest durability_bar (0.83) and strong breadth (0.846), and it is not crowded (z 0.88). This is a cleaner trend-health profile than the AI-heavy leaders, offering exposure to the same tech-trend complex without the AI-infra fading-tag or the cybersecurity crowding flag. Trend gate is satisfied and the leg is coherent.
theses.dissent: This theme sits inside the broader tech complex that is heavily represented at the top of the leaderboard; if the AI-driven tech leadership rolls over broadly, non-AI hardware will not be insulated, and rank 9 suggests it is a laggard leg of the same trade, not an independent driver.

falsifier.text: XLK's non-AI hardware constituents underperform SMH by more than 5% cumulatively over the next 20 trading days
